In this episode of The Ranveer Show, we welcome Vinay Varanasi. He is a Bengaluru-based storyteller and artist who has accumulated vast knowledge about Sanatan Dharma, spirituality, and Indian culture. In this episode, we will talk about Vishnu and his Dashavataras.

In this episode, we talked about the concept of Vishnu and his various avatars, exploring how he is seen as the sustainer of the universe and the source of life. The hosts discuss the intricate details of Vishnu's avatars, highlighting the symbolism and the stories behind them. They also discuss the importance of sadhana and how it can help people connect with the divine.

This was an amazing episode about Lord Vishnu. I am sure that with this episode, we will gain a bit more understanding of Indian mythology and more. I hope you will enjoy this episode and let me know your thoughts in the comments section.

snippet.description:
Duty Se Market Tak | Aaj Ka Mini Vlog 🥬🐟

✨ A normal workday, but with a few unexpected moments! ✨

Aaj ka din duty par ek simple kaam se start hua, lekin jaise-jaise din guzarta gaya, vlog mein work ke saath daily life ke kuch real moments bhi judte gaye. 📏🏢

Duty ke beech ek kaam ke liye nikalna, raaste ke busy city views, greenery aur work moments… aur phir lunch break ke kuch simple moments. 🌿🚶‍♂️

Shaam ko ghar lautte waqt ek chhota sa market stop ho gaya 🐟🥬—fresh fish aur vegetables lete hue kuch moments camera mein capture ho gaye. Kabhi-kabhi daily life ke ye small moments hi vlog ko real banate hain. ❤️
Mirror mein ek quick shot, haath mein shopping bags aur phir ghar ki taraf wapas… 🛍️🏠

No fancy plan, just a real day from my life. ❤️
Agar aapko Daily Mini Vlog, Work Life Vlog aur Real Life Moments pasand hain, to video ko Like 👍 karein, Comment karke batayein ki aapke din ka sabse interesting moment kya tha, aur Channel ko Subscribe 🔔 zaroor karein.

Watch till the end & stay connected! ❤️


#MiniVlog #DailyVlog #WorkVlog #DailyLife #YouTubeShorts
